name: maintenanceos
description: MaintenanceOS - API-first ERP for a property maintenance business (API + MCP). Web SPA lives in maintenanceOS-web.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/arag-client && npm run build --workspace packages/mcp-core && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/arag-client && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/mcp-core && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/mcp
